violations.reason: VR-positive verdict with baseline_accuracy=0.000 is implausible — modern LLMs score at least 5% on GSM8K-class tasks without special prompting.  A near-zero baseline indicates the baseline code path is broken (wrong prompt template, grader regex mismatch, or silent short-circuit), not that the repair improved reasoning.

Verdict claims publishable but classifier has zero true positives across all datasets: {'hackaprompt': 0, 'bipia': 0, 'synthetic': 0}.  At the decision threshold used, the model flags nothing as the positive class.  AUROC may be high but the classifier is unusable without threshold calibration.

Cross-dataset AUROC (0.9585) exceeds training-distribution AUROC (0.7995) by +0.1590, which is physically implausible in real ML — generalization should degrade (or at most stay flat) on truly-held-out data.  The OOD datasets likely share a spurious artifact the model latched onto.
